description: Master bus for a Daisy Mix chain, summing the strips linked to its left into a stereo output

params.text: Sets the level of the mix, silence fully left, 0dB at noon and +6dB fully right
Mutes the master bus and lights red, despite the README describing a long-press solo on this button

inputs.text: Scales the mix level, 0-10V for silence to the MASTER setting, with voltage outside that range clamped

outputs.text: The left side of the chain mix, clamped to -12V to 12V before the MASTER knob and the level CV are applied, despite the README putting that clamp on the output
The right side of the chain mix, clamped to -12V to 12V before the MASTER knob and the level CV are applied, despite the README putting that clamp on the output

notes: The master takes the mix from the daisy module touching its left edge, so it goes at the right-hand end of the chain, and up to 16 strips can feed it
When a strip anywhere in the chain is soloed, only the soloed strips reach the outputs
With the mouse over this module, pressing m toggles mute
The outputs carry nothing until at least one DC2 strip touches the chain to the left; the master has no input jacks of its own.
menu: Smooth level CV — adds a 6ms slew to the level CV input, softening abrupt changes of level; it is ticked by default
Create 1 channel — places one DC2 strip to the left of the master, touching it, so it is linked into the chain
Create 1 channel with vu meter — places one DC2 strip to the left of the master with a VU meter module beside it
Create 2 channels — places two DC2 strips to the left of the master, touching it and each other
Create 2 channels with vu meters — places two DC2 strips to the left of the master, each with a VU meter module beside it
Create 2 channels with vu meters + aux sends — places two DC2 strips with meters, then a blank separator, two AUX modules and two more DC2 strips with meters to bring the aux signal back
Create 4 channels — places four DC2 strips to the left of the master, touching it and each other
Create 4 channels with vu meters — places four DC2 strips to the left of the master, each with a VU meter module beside it
Create 4 channels with vu meters + aux sends — places four DC2 strips with meters, then a blank separator, two AUX modules and two more DC2 strips with meters to bring the aux signal back
